hints.title: Deficit Reset Starting Point Property
hints.text: If total gas is less than total cost, completing the circuit is impossible. If total gas is sufficient, what property ensures a unique valid start station exists?

hints.title: Negative Tank Segment Pruning Invariant
hints.text: If running tank drops below zero between station A and station B, no station between A and B inclusive can serve as a valid starting point.

hints.title: Single Pass Tank Accumulation Procedure
hints.text: Verify that sum of gas is at least sum of cost. Iterate through stations maintaining running tank. Whenever the tank drops below zero, reset tank to zero and set the candidate starting station to the next index. Return the final candidate station.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input array length or bit count
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating the entire circuit starting from every station takes O(N^2) time, which times out for N = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single greedy pass identifies the unique valid starting index in O(N) time with O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should prove mathematically why total gas >= total cost guarantees a solution, and why resetting start to i + 1 works.
